paper_title: Memorization and Knowledge Injection in Gated LLMs
caption: Analysis on the embedding quality in Llama intermediate layers. Correct gate rate is computed as the rate of question embeddings which have the maximum inner product with the relevant passage embedding. It is computed for each dataset partition, which has 50 passage samples. Shaded area is the standard deviation across 20 dataset partitions. We found that embeddings at the input of MLP layers are better than at the input of attention layers. We choose to use last MLP layer input as embedding in the main experiments of MEGa.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the Average Correct Gate Rate across the Embedding Layer for four different input configurations, with shaded regions of a lighter corresponding color indicating variance around each line. The x-axis is labeled "Embedding Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 32, without specific units, displaying numeric tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Average Correct Gate Rate," uses a linear scale with an explicitly labeled range from 0.2 to 1.0 and tick intervals of 0.2, though the plotted data extends slightly below the 0.2 mark. The plot contains four lines, none of which use distinct markers. The solid light blue line, representing "Character Attention input," begins at approximately 0.1 at layer 0, rises sharply to a peak near 0.8 at layer 5, declines to a minimum of about 0.25 at layer 12, and then experiences a fluctuating upward trend, ending at roughly 0.73 at layer 31. The dashed light blue line, labeled "Character MLP input," starts at approximately 0.82, reaches an initial peak of about 0.94 at layer 3, drops to near 0.53 at layer 12, and then rises to maintain a high plateau, peaking again around 0.92 near layer 23 before concluding at roughly 0.82. The solid dark red line for "Wiki Attention input" starts at 0.2, climbs to a peak of approximately 0.8 at layer 5, descends to about 0.38 at layer 13, and then generally increases with some fluctuations to finish near 0.7 at layer 31. Finally, the dashed dark red line corresponding to "Wiki MLP input" begins at around 0.82, peaks near 0.88 at layer 3, drops to approximately 0.6 at layer 12, rises to a high of about 0.89 near layer 24, and ends at approximately 0.85 at layer 31.
